title: CAPIT States | Compare Well Plugging by State
description: Explore CAPIT’s state-by-state pages for well-plugging records, source agencies, recent activity, and coverage notes.
headline: Explore Well Plugging by State
body: Browse the states CAPIT currently covers, compare high-level activity, and open detailed state pages for source definitions, recent records, and strict publication notes.

sections.heading: Tracking Regional Infrastructure
sections.body: A good state comparison view does more than rank totals. It must provide context by showing coverage scope, update cadence, and the specific regulatory agency behind the numbers.

sections.heading: Primary Tracked States
sections.body:
CAPIT tracks P&A filings across major energy-producing states, including:
* Texas: Overseen by the Railroad Commission of Texas.
* Pennsylvania: Overseen by the PA Dept. of Environmental Protection.
* Oklahoma: Administered by the OK Corporation Commission.
* California: Verified deserted and plugged wells tracked by CalGEM.
* Kansas & New Mexico: Extensive historic well records ingested from KCC and OCD direct feeds.

sections.heading: Data Normalization & Ingestion
sections.body: CAPIT utilizes comprehensive scraping fallbacks and API gateways to extract CSV/XLSX bundles directly from state hosts (including AK, KS, CA, KY, LA, MO, MT, NM, NV, SD, TN, UT, WY) ensuring the highest fidelity in tracking physical environmental restoration.
